text: RESULTS: The infant has not been observed to turn blue (cyanosis) during episodes, and feeding difficulties were not reported in response to the specific inquiry regarding "tet spells" or exhaustion during pauses, though the clinical picture of apnea and tachycardia remains concerning.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital High-Output Heart Failure secondary to a large Ventricular Septal Defect (VSD) or Patent Ductus Arteriosus (PDA). The absence of cyanosis ("blue spells") and feeding fatigue, combined with apnea and anemia, points toward a left-to-right shunt causing pulmonary overcirculation and congestive heart failure rather than a right-sided obstructive lesion like Tetralogy of Fallot. Please confirm the Echocardiogram results immediately.
